Protocol M - Malaria

Protocol cds protocol burn wound

Evidence: Grade B (traditional_use)

Summary

Burn support protocol using CDS for healing and tissue repair support.

Indications

  • Malaria
  • Parasitic treatment

Steps

  1. Prepare burn support dose
  2. Follow support protocol
  3. Monitor healing
  4. Track symptoms
  5. Support with appropriate care

Dosage

Burn support protocol: 1 ml CDS in 100ml water, 2 times daily

Expected Outcomes

  • Burn healing
  • Tissue repair
  • Healing support
  • Wound resolution

Monitoring

  • Monitor burn healing
  • Track wound status
  • Watch for infection
  • Medical supervision for severe burns

Frequency: 2 times daily
